## Change

Describe the focused change and affected workflow.

## Verification

List checks actually run, behavior observed and remaining gaps. For UI changes,
include rendered interaction evidence with private content removed.

## Data and permissions

- [ ] No private data, credentials, machine bindings or unlicensed assets included.
- [ ] New dependencies/assets have license and source information.
- [ ] Changes to device authority, CLI schemas or debug access are documented.
